summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Precision Drilling Corporation, a Canadian oil & gas drilling company, providing its interim financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes certifications by the CEO and CFO under Canadian securities law (Form 52-109F2) regarding the accuracy and fairness of the interim filings. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special situation. This is a standard periodic reporting obligation, not a special event.
